name: AT-TE Titanfall Tactical Cockpit HUD
description: Titanfall-style armored tactical cockpit visor HUD (compass tape, hull-vs-look indicator, pitch ladder, hull integrity bar, live ordnance counters, 6-leg AT-TE chassis telemetry, optical boot sequence) and optional F7 1P forward-canopy / 3P dual-view toggle for Clonedivers AT-TE combat walkers.
